subject: Taxes
title: Framing Tax as Investment
description: A fast breakdown of Framing Tax as Investment for builders.

hook.text: When Guatemala reframed taxes as 'your contribution to schools and hospitals.

buildup.text: Most tax communications focus on obligation and penalty.

discovery.text: Oregon created the 'Where Does My Tax Go?' tool, showing each dollar's allocation.

twist.text: But the frame backfires if people don't value what government provides.

climax.text: Framing only works when there's a genuine value exchange. The best nudge in the world can't fix bad governance.

punchline.text: Show what taxes buy. 43% more compliance. But only if the value is real.

quiz.question: What happened when Guatemala reframed taxes as contributions?
